d: Duniya ke samne aaj svasthy kshetr ki ek naee chunauti jo teji se ubhar rahi hai vah hai - entibayotik davaon ka beasar hona. jin davaon ke sahare kabhi samany baiktiriyal sankraman ka ilaj aasani se ho jata tha, ab kaee baiktiriya unke khilaph pratirodhak kshamta viksit kar chuke hain. medikal sains men ise entimaikrobiyal rejistens yani AMR kaha jata hai. chinta ki bat yah hai ki nimoniya, yurinri traikt inphekshan aur blad inphekshan jaisi bimariyon ka ilaj bhi mushkil hota ja raha hai.
